summary.intent: Drive Wave 4 and Wave 5 of the CipherBox v2 rewrite to completion: rebase, review-cycle, and merge queues of draft PRs unattended overnight and during the day, then plan and partially launch Wave 5/6, clean up tracker/branch hygiene, and fix a stale staging environment-variable naming scheme and its dead redis/tee-worker services.
summary.outcome: All six Wave 4 PRs and all seven Wave 5 PRs were reviewed, resolved, verified to combine, and merged; tracker hygiene (milestones, parenting, comp labels, stale blocked_by edges) was corrected; issue #981 was closed with residue tracked; branch protection was tightened; Wave 6 was planned (8 PRs) with #648 split into 4 sequenced sub-issues; and a staging env-var rename (STAGING_ prefix removal, IPFS_GATEWAY_URL, redis/tee-worker teardown) is in progress on PR #1113.

repo: `recycle-both.sh` is the working review-cycle script; `review2.sh`/`cycle.sh` are broken and must not be used — any of their historical logs may report false all-clears

A `success` conclusion on a macroscope check-run does NOT mean zero findings — findings can post minutes after check-runs complete (up to ~9 min later on #1104), so threads must always be re-queried, never inferred from conclusion
CodeRabbit's clean verdict posts to the status comment only, never a review entry — polling review bodies alone hangs to timeout

Two PRs adding an identical field/enum-variant to the same file merge textually clean into a duplicate/non-exhaustive-match compile break; git reports no conflict — must build+compile the combined tree, not trust `mergeable`

gh REST `/issues/N --jq '.parent'` always returns null — a false negative; must use the GraphQL parent lookup before judging umbrella-issue completeness, or orphaned children (e.g. #1050 under #989) get silently missed
GitHub environment-variables API paginates at 10 per page by default with no warning — must pass per_page and compare against total_count, or existing vars (e.g. STAGING_API_URL) appear to not exist
Parallel agents share one scratchpad directory, one Puppeteer browser instance, and dev-server ports — must give each agent a unique scratchpad path/port or work silently clobbers

Reviewer-suggested diffs are frequently unsafe if applied literally: `{other:?}` would have required deriving Debug on a Zeroizing-wrapped secret type; `clear_session` would destroy a valid refresh credential turning a wedge into a DoS; a proposed helper ignored its parameters and returned a constant

GitHub Actions secrets are write-only on both API and UI — no way to read a value back; rotation requires generate-and-set, and paired external state (DB passwords, SSH keys) needs manual coordination, not blind rotation

`docker-compose.staging.yml` had declared `redis` and `tee-worker` services referencing undefined/unused env vars — v2's API has zero redis dependency despite the workflow header already stating redis was removed with the v1 layout
`crates/engine/src/content/profile.rs` PRODUCTION chunk_size=1_048_536 is deliberate seal-overhead accounting `(1<<20) - NONCE_LEN - TAG_LEN`, not a typo, per `crates/core/src/suite/aead.rs:103`

Faked seam traits (only test-module implementors of a trait) are invisible tracker gaps — code compiles, tests pass, reads as delivered; must check whether the primitive has any production caller at all (`rotate_scope`/`rotate_scope_write` had none)

code.finding: `reseal_verdict` exhaustive match over `ResealError` — required updating when #1098 added `TooManyCommittedGrants` variant; the no-catch-all design is what made the semantic merge conflict a compile error rather than a silent miscategorization
Signed `body.challenge` from server response with no prefix validation — live signing oracle on the identity key, fixed in #1099/#1034 by pinning the exact prefix+hex shape
`rebase_update_content` never reads `op.base_sequence` — a present target applies unconditionally, enabling silent last-write-wins clobber of concurrent content writes (filed as #1106)
`Command::Grant` (not `Command::Share`) is the actual variant name; catch-all fallthrough for unimplemented commands is at line 2278
`WriteSubtreeResolver` has no production implementation — only test fakes; trait doc explicitly notes real network/gate wiring is not landed (led to filing #1108)

Result-gate vacuity: `web-e2e`/`web-e2e-result` (and identically-shaped `desktop-build`/`desktop-build-result`) pass when the guarded job is `skipped`, so if the upstream `Detect Changes` job fails, the gate reports green having verified nothing

workflow: Build and compile the full N-way combined merge tree (all target PRs' final heads asserted as ancestors) before declaring a wave ready, not just pairwise `mergeable` checks — this is the only way to catch semantic (non-textual) merge conflicts
Read exit codes directly/unpiped (`cmd >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?`) — piping through `tail`/`grep` masks the real command's exit status

When cleaning up worktrees/branches, verify each against its merged PR (or record SHAs) before deleting, since squash-merges mean branch tips are never ancestors of main — reachability checks alone will falsely flag merged work as unmerged
Give every parallel/background agent a unique scratchpad file path and, where relevant, unique ports — a generic shared filename gets silently overwritten by a sibling agent

Never apply a code-review suggested diff literally — treat it as a symptom report; verify the underlying mechanism and check whether the fix itself introduces a regression (e.g. deriving Debug on a secret type, destroying valid credentials)
When an umbrella/tracking issue shows 0 open children, verify with a proper GraphQL parent lookup before closing it — REST's null `.parent` bug creates false completions

Fence bot-rate-limited actions (e.g. CodeRabbit's 1/hr slot) using timestamps from the authoritative source (GitHub) with a safety buffer, never a local tool's clock (vitest prints local time, not UTC)

When a required CI check is intermittently flaky, verify isolation (does it fail across all PRs or just one) before assuming a real regression, and re-run the specific job rather than the whole workflow when it's `workflow_call`-based (can't be rerun standalone)

friction: macroscope ran out of credits mid-wave (00:54Z), silently degrading review coverage on 6 of 7 Wave 5 PRs since the script initially scored 'skipped' check-runs as full coverage
Web E2E Smoke Result flaky test (`smoke.spec.ts:43` sign-out redirect) intermittently blocks unrelated engine-only PRs now that the gate is required
Greptile has been quota-locked since before Wave 4 and remained so through Wave 5/6 planning
Repeated transient GitHub API network outages during the overnight run required retry/notifier logic to avoid stalling the review cycles

Several of my own verification checks used loose substring matching that produced false positives (issue parenting/dependency edges, worktree removal success) — required explicit read-back verification to catch
gh api's `--arg` flag doesn't exist and silently breaks jq filters, an error that had gone undetected in the prior `review2.sh` script for its entire lifetime
Locked harness-managed worktrees (still resumable by finished agents) couldn't be force-removed, requiring `git -C` workarounds in follow-up agents
